content:
maria: Heads-up — aiming for go-live next Wed 10:00am PT. Need final changelog link + docs anchor and confirmation of the rollout window. Can eng confirm staged timing? cc @sam @olivia

sam: We can hit that. Planning a model swap during low traffic; target window 09:30–10:00 PT for canary, ramp to 100% by 10:00 PT. Will that work for marketing?

lee: Prefer EU first for the canary, then US. Ops will watch error rates. Changelog PR ready, just needs perf bullets.

olivia: Docs PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/456 — waiting on the perf stat and one callout about rollback behavior. I can merge and publish once we have the numbers.

maria: Marketing wants a single headline stat for the release (latency or cost). Can eng provide a short sentence (2–3 lines) we can paste into the changelog and social post?

sam: Quick draft: "median generation latency improved ~18% with new batching pipeline; end-to-end cost per 1k tokens reduced ~25% for typical chat workloads." I'll add exact measured values to the PR by EOD.

lee: Also add the rollback note: auto-fallback to v1 if error rate >1% sustained for 5m. Ops will run the rollback playbook in that case.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-04-01T16:30:00Z -> 2026-04-01T18:00:00Z (canary EU -> US). Runbook: /runbooks/release-2026-04

maria: Webinar slot: marketing booked Tue 11:00am PT for a 30-min demo with product. Need a final demo checklist and presenters. @lee who will present runtime bits?

lee: I'll present the runtime optimizations + a short CLI rollback demo. @sam can cover quantization perf and the latency numbers.

sam: Yep. I'll prepare a 3-min perf demo and slides. Also need a sample prompt set from marketing to validate canaries.

maria: Uploading prompt set here: https://drive.redwood.ai/pm/promptset-v2 — please validate with canary traffic. Also, inbound lead routing: sales requests leads tagged "release_2026_04" with a 48-hour SLA.

olivia: Docs will include a contact + support path. Can someone add the CRM tag mapping so webforms and demo regs auto-tag?

sam: Ops will add a webhook to the CRM that tags leads with `release_2026_04`. Example snippet for the webhook payload:

```json
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "tags": ["release_2026_04"]
}
```

I'll have that live by tomorrow morning.

lee: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/89 — waiting on docs + legal sign-off. Once merged, please ping me so we can coordinate the publish time.

maria: Final checklist we need before marketing pushes: 1) changelog PR merged, 2) docs published with anchor, 3) webinar slides & demo ready, 4) canary window confirmed, 5) lead-routing webhook active. Who owns "merge + publish"?

olivia: I can merge docs once eng signs off on the perf numbers. Maria — what time should we publish the post?

maria: Publish at 10:00 PT when go-live completes. Marketing will post social at 10:05 PT and send the email at 10:15 PT.

sam: Plan: start canary at 09:30 PT, monitor for 30m, ramp to 100% by 10:00 PT if no alarms. Ops alert thresholds: 1% error rate or >2x baseline latency percentile.

lee: If we hit thresholds, ops will cut traffic to v1 and alert #incidents. Rollback runbook is linked in the deploy window.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll update the release calendar and share the runbook link in the morning. Thanks all.

sam: Added measured numbers to the docs PR: median latency 120ms -> 98ms; cost per 1k tokens $0.42 -> $0.31. Please sanity-check before merge.

olivia: Docs published and anchor created: https://docs.redwood.ai/whats-new/2026-04-release — ready to link from changelog.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary EU. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/12345

maria: Copy. Marketing to prep the email and webinar registration flow.

lee: All green on our side.

maria: Great work — I'll send the final runbook + timeline to the calendar and ping this thread when everything is merged/published.
